reading: Many young people use technology to help with job applications.
They use it to write cover letters or CVs.
This helps candidates send multiple applications at the same time.
Now, companies receive large volumes of applications.
Some managers do not blame them because the jobs market is difficult.
However, some people use the technology to cheat on assessments.
Employers still want to see the real personality of each person.

vocabulary.definition: computers, programs, and machines that help people do things.
documents that show a person's education and work history.
people who are trying to get a job.
the number of jobs available for people who need work.
to do something dishonest to get an advantage.
the character and qualities that make a person who they are.
